title: credential body claude_subscription
description: Plaintext body of the credential kind claude_subscription inside the record ciphertext (04-crypto.md section 4.4). kind setup_token: a long-lived token of `claude setup-token`; kind oauth_login (ADR-092): the full login of `claude auth login` on a platform device - token is the current access token, renewed by the measuring device with refresh_token before expires_at; kind login_token: the access token of the user's local Claude Code login, transferred by the user's agent tool, with its expiry (11-agent-access.md section 8, ADR-056). Several records per user (ADR-090): name and note are the owner's label and remark, use says which sessions besides the owner's own (the primary record) may use it; a record without token is not logged in (it serves nothing and is not measured). mailbox (KOR-73) is the subscription's own mailbox: the IMAP access of the mailbox automation for this subscription, written by the owner's client and kept by every login and renewal.

name.description: the owner's label of the subscription (no control character)

note.description: the owner's remark: what the subscription is for (no line break)

expires_at.description: expiry of the access token (login_token and oauth_login)

refresh_token.description: the refresh token of an oauth_login (printable ASCII without spaces); never handed to a session

scopes.description: the scopes of the oauth_login (a login is taken only with user:profile and user:inference)

subscription_type.description: the plan of the subscription as the program names it (e.g. max, pro)

rate_limit_tier.description: the rate-limit tier as the program names it

relogin.description: set by the measuring device when the provider refused the refresh token (invalid_grant): the record has no token and must be logged in again

pool.description: the operator's pool: the organizations the root-signed platform log grants the operator's subscriptions; counts only for an owner with the platform role operator

orgs.description: organizations, each at most once (checked by the clients and the runner)

use.description: which sessions besides the owner's own may use the subscription (ADR-090 section 3); absent or empty: measure only

mailbox.description: the subscription's own mailbox (KOR-73, ADR-099): the automatic login and every new login of this subscription read the sign-in mail there
